The '''''Spotty Conveyor''''' was a [[Garbage scow/Legends|Trade Federation scow]] that was transporting radioactive waste from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation]]-owned factory [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to [[PDC3141-02]], a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planetoid, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Crewed by six beings, the ship was unable to dump its waste on the planetoid when [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from the [[University of Sanbra]] discovered unicellular microbial life on PDC3141-02 and obtained an injunction to stop all dumping. The ''Conveyor'' was unable to leave the [[Star system/Legends|system]], however, as it did not have enough fuel left to depart with a full load. To make matters worse, the ''Conveyor''{{'s}} [[rad-dampening shielding]] was failing; once the shielding was gone, the crew would be exposed to the radioactive waste. Federation [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] attempted to bypass the injunction and allow the scow to dump its cargo and leave the system.
